qe: At Lucknow the Shah of Oudh presented Kunwar Singh with a robe of honour, twelve thousand rupees in cash and a firman for which district?
qh: लखनऊ में अवध के शाह ने कुंवर सिंह को खिलअत, बारह हज़ार रुपये नकद तथा किस जिले का फरमान भेंट किया?
e: August 1857 me Kunwar Singh Bihar chhod kar anya kshetron me bhi British sena ke khilaf ladte rahe; woh Rewa, Gwalior, Lucknow tatha Azamgarh jaise sthalon tak gaye. Lucknow me avadh ke shah ne unhe sammanit kiya tatha khilat yaani bhavya vastra, barah hazaar rupaye nakad tatha Azamgarh jile ka farman bhaint kiya. Farman yaani shahi aadesh-patra, jisse kisi kshetra ka prabandh tatha aay ka adhikar diya jata tha. Yah samman dikhata hai ki Kunwar Singh ki khyaati Bihar ki seema se bahar bhi phail chuki thi tatha anya riyasaton ke shasak unhe apna sahayak maan rahe the. Us samay British sarkar ke liye yah ek badi chunauti thi, kyunki unhe lagta tha ki Kunwar Singh Patna par hamla kar sakte hain. Exam point: Lucknow me avadh ke shah ne Kunwar Singh ko khilat, barah hazaar rupaye tatha Azamgarh jile ka farman diya tha.

qe: Kunwar Singh joined a band of his comrades at which place, about twenty-five miles from Azamgarh, on 17 March 1858?
qh: 17 मार्च 1858 को कुंवर सिंह आज़मगढ़ से लगभग पच्चीस मील दूर किस स्थान पर अपने साथियों की टोली से मिले?
e: 1858 ke aarambh me Kunwar Singh ki sena azadi ki ladai ka ek prabhavshali kendra ban chuki thi. Woh Rewa ki sena me shamil hone ki koshish karne Rewa gaye, phir Banda tatha Kalpi hokar Kanpur ki ladai me hissa liya tatha aage Lucknow pahunche. Azamgarh se pandrah meel ke aas-paas Atrauha naam ke sthal par 17 March 1858 ko woh apne saathiyon ki ek toli se mile. Iske kuchh hi din baad Colonel Milman ke netritva wali British sena ne un par hamla kiya, lekin woh khud har gayi tatha bhaag kar Azamgarh ke morche me chhup gayi. Kunwar Singh ke saathiyon ne peechha karke 26 March ko Azamgarh par adhikar kar liya, jisse ek mahatvapurna kshetra unke haath me aa gaya. Exam point: Kunwar Singh 17 March 1858 ko Azamgarh se pandrah meel door Atrauha me apne saathiyon se mile, aur 26 March ko unke saathiyon ne Azamgarh par adhikar kar liya.

qe: Wounded and with one arm lost in the fight against Brigadier Douglas's troops, Kunwar Singh crossed the Ganges the same night at which ghat?
qh: ब्रिगेडियर डगलस की सैनिकों से लड़ाई में घायल होकर और एक हाथ खोकर कुंवर सिंह उसी रात गंगा नदी किस घाट पर पार कर गए?
e: 21 April 1858 ko Kunwar Singh ki sena tatha Brigadier Douglas ki angreji sena ke beech bhari yuddh hua. Is ladai me Kunwar Singh bahut veerta se lade tatha bahut ghayal hone ke saath-saath unka ek hath bhi kat gaya, lekin unka sahas nahi toota. Usi raat woh ganga nadi paar kar Gaye tatha Shivapur ghat se hokar doosre kinare par pahunche; saath hi doosre kinare ke gaon ke logon ne unki sena ki bharpoor sahayata ki. Us samay woh assi saal se zyada ki umar ke the, isliye unke is sahas tatha hausle ne unke saathiyon ke manobal ko aur bhi badhaya. Is sangharsh ke baad woh apne thikane Jagdishpur ki or badhe, jahan unke saathiyon ne Captain Le Grand ki sena ko kadak jawab diya. Exam point: 21 April 1858 ki ladai me ghayal aur ek hath khone ke baad bhi Kunwar Singh usi raat Shivapur ghat se ganga paar kar gaye the.

qe: Kunwar Singh died how long after his victory over Captain Le Grand's troops at Jagdishpur?
qh: जगदीशपुर में कैप्टन ले ग्रां की सैना पर विजय पाने के कितने दिन बाद कुंवर सिंह का देहांत हो गया?
e: 23 April 1858 ko Jagdishpur me Captain Le Grand ki angreji sena ko Karari haar machi; is ladai me unke saathiyon ne angreji sena ke kai top bhi chheen liye tatha uski toli ke bahut se sipahi mar gaye. Lekin yah unki antim vijay sabit hui. Lambe samay ki thakan tatha nirantar ladai ne unhe tod diya tatha is vijay ke keval teen din baad hi, 26 April 1858 ko unka dehant ho gaya. Unki mrutyu ke baad bhi unke saathi hausla nahi hare; unke bhai Amar Singh tatha Joodhun Singh tatha anya saathiyon ne Bihar ke alag-alag hisson me sangharsh jari rakha tatha Jagdishpur me ek samantar sarkar tak chalayi. Isi kaaran angreji sarkar ko unke kshetra me kai mahine tak ashaanti rahi. Exam point: Captain Le Grand ki sena par vijay ke keval teen din baad, 26 April 1858 ko Kunwar Singh ka dehant ho gaya, lekin unke saathiyon ne sangharsh jari rakha.

qe: Kunwar Singh's brother Amar Singh was captured about the middle of December 1859 and died in which jail on 5 February 1860?
qh: कुंवर सिंह के भाई अमर सिंह दिसंबर 1859 के मध्य में पकड़े गए थे तथा 5 फरवरी 1860 को किस कारागार में उनका देहांत हुआ?
e: Kunwar Singh ke dehant ke baad unke bhai Amar Singh ne sangharsh ka netritva sambhala. Nana Saheb ke Nepal ki or bhaag jane ke baad Amar Singh tarai kshetra me gaye, taaki Nana Saheb ki sena ka netritva sambhal sake. Woh alag-alag sthalon par angreji sena se ladte rahe tatha unke saath anek gaon ke log bhi the; ant me December 1859 ke madhya me woh angreji sarkar ke haath pakad liye gaye. Unhe apne hi zile me mukadme ki sunwai ke liye Gorakhpur jail me rakha gaya, lekin 5 February 1860 ko pet kee bimari se unka dehant ho gaya; unka mukadma poori tarah shuru hi nahi ho saka tha. Is tarah 1857 ke vidroh ka yah sangharsh Bhojpur tatha purvanchal me 1860 tak chala. Exam point: Amar Singh December 1859 me pakde gaye tatha 5 February 1860 ko Gorakhpur jail me unka dehant ho gaya.

qe: Birsa, under whose leadership the Munda movement of Chotanagpur took shape, was a Munda of which village in Tamar thana?
qh: जिनके नेतृत्व में छोटानागपुर का मुंडा आंदोलन खड़ा हुआ, वे बिरसा तमाड़ थाने के किस गाँव के मुंडा थे?
e: Unnisvin sadi ke ant me Chotanagpur ke Ranchi tatha Singhbhum kshetra me kai krishi-sambandhi aandolan dabaye gaye the, lekin asantosh khatm nahi hui. 1831 se 1895 tak ke isi asantosh ne ek zyada bada roop liya, jiska netritva Birsa naam ke ek Munda yuva ne kiya. Birsa Tamar thana me base Chalkad gaon ka rahne wala Munda tha; Munda Chotanagpur ka ek pramukh aadivasi samuday hai, jo gaon ke mukhiya yaani Munda ke netritva me rehta tha. 1895 me Birsa tatha uske anuyayiyon ko giraftar kar liya gaya, lekin jail se riha hone ke baad usne apne kaam ko aur zyada tez kiya. Apni dharmik bhavna tatha lokapriyata ke kaaran woh aage chalkar Birsa Bhagwan ke naam se prasiddh hua tatha uske netritva me chala aandolan ko Ulgulan kaha gaya. Exam point: Birsa Tamar thana ke Chalkad gaon ka Munda tha; Munda Chotanagpur ka pramukh aadivasi samuday hai, aur Birsa ke netritva wale aandolan ko Ulgulan kaha jaata hai.

qe: Detachments of the Ramgarh Battalion at which two places revolted on 5 August 1857, following the example of the sepoys at Hazaribagh?
qh: हजारीबाग के सिपाहियों का उदाहरण अपनाते हुए रामगढ़ बटालियन की टुकड़ियों ने 5 अगस्त 1857 को किन दो स्थानों पर विद्रोह किया?
e: July 1857 me Hazaribagh me tainat saatvin tatha aathvin Native Infantry ki tukadiyon ne vidroh kar diya tatha Ramgarh battalion ke sainikon ne bhi unka saath diya. Ranchi to Ramgarh battalion ka headquarters tatha artillery ka sthal tha, tatha Chaibasa tatha Purulia me bhi usi battalion ki tukadiyan tainat thin. Isi silsile me 5 August 1857 ko Purulia tatha Chaibasa ki Ramgarh Battalion tukadiyon ne khule vidroh kar diya. Iske baad unke saathi 11 September ko Doranda se chal pade tatha Ghouriya me unhe Bhola Singh naam ke ek zamindar bhi mila; isi tarah vidroh ka daayra Ranchi, Hazaribagh, Palamau tatha Singhbhum tak phailta gaya. Alag-alag sthalon se uthe is vidroh ne angreji hukumat ke liye Chotanagpur me bahut badi chunauti khadi kar di. Exam point: Ramgarh Battalion ki Purulia tatha Chaibasa wali tukadiyon ne 5 August 1857 ko vidroh kiya; Ranchi Ramgarh battalion ka headquarters tha tatha Doranda ki tukadi 11 September ko wahan se chali.

qe: In Palamau the Bhogtas, under the leadership of which two of their chiefs, organized themselves into a large force and attacked Chainpur on 21 October 1857?
qh: पलामू में भोगता लोग किन दो सरदारों के नेतृत्व में एक बड़ी सेना बनाकर 21 अक्टूबर 1857 को चैनपुर पर हमला किया?
oe: Bhola Singh and Nadir Ali Khan
Tikait Unao Rao and Shaikh Bikari
oh: भोला सिंह तथा नादिर अली खान
टिकैत उनाओ राव तथा शेख बिकारी
e: Palamau kshetra me bhi 1857 ka vidroh bahut bhaari roop le chuka tha. Bhogta yaani Bhogta kisan samuday ke do sardaar, Pitambar tatha Lilambar, jinke saath Kharwar jaati ke log tatha Chero samuday ke log shamil ho gaye, mil kar ek badi sena banayi. Is sena ne 21 October 1857 ko Chainpur par hamla kiya tatha aage badh kar Shahpur pahunchi, jahan unhone Rani, yaani Raja Churaman ki patni, ki char topen bhi chheen lin tatha sthaniya police ko haraya. Vidrohiyon ne Lt. Graham ko Raghubir Dayal ke makan me gher liya, jo angreji sarkar ka sahayak tha. November me vidrohiyon ne Rajhara me coal company ke station par bhi hamla kiya tatha 2 December ko Manka tatha Chatarput ke thanon par hamla kiya, jisse poore kshetra me angreji prashasan ki kamar tutne lagi. Exam point: Palamau me Bhogta sardaar Pitambar tatha Lilambar ne Kharwar tatha Chero logon ke saath mil kar 21 October 1857 ko Chainpur par hamla kiya tatha aage Shahpur me Rani ki char topen chheen lin.

qe: Birsa came to be known as Birsa Bhagwan on account of which two qualities?
qh: किन दो गुणों के कारण बिरसा को बिरसा भगवान के नाम से जाना जाने लगा?
oe: His skill in trade and his large family
His religious zeal and his popularity
His skill in warfare and his wealth
His knowledge of English and his contacts with officials
oh: उसकी धार्मिक भावना तथा उसकी लोकप्रियता
अंग्रेजी का ज्ञान तथा अधिकारियों से संपर्क
e: Birsa ek sadharan Munda yuva tha, lekin uski dharmik bhavna tatha logon ke beech uski lokapriyata ne use logon ke dil me utaar diya. Yah log use Birsa Bhagwan ke naam se pukarne lage, yaani woh unke liye ek dharmik neta tatha rakshak ban gaya. British sarkar usko ek khatarnak vidrohi tatha upadravi samajhti thi, jabki aam logon ke liye woh unke dukh-dard ka saathi tha. Uska maksad tha samajik buriyon ka ant karna, tatha isi ke saath angreji hukumat tatha uske sahayakon ko hatane ki ichha bhi judi hui thi. Apni lokapriyata ke kaaran woh gaon-gaon ja kar logon ko ek kar sakta tha tatha alag-alag gaon ke log uske saath aandolan me shamil hote gaye. Exam point: Birsa apni dharmik bhavna tatha lokapriyata ke kaaran Birsa Bhagwan kehlaya; British sarkar use vidrohi maanti thi, lekin aam logon ke liye woh unke dukh ka saathi tha.

qe: The insurgents who left Doranda on 11 September 1857 were joined at Ghouriya by Bhola Singh, and probably intended to join Kunwar Singh's troops at which place?
qh: 11 सितंबर 1857 को दोरंडा से निकले विद्रोहियों से घौरिया में भोला सिंह मिले, और उनका विचार कुंवर सिंह की सैना से किस स्थान पर मिलने का था?
e: Hazaribagh tatha Ranchi ke vidroh ke baad Ramgarh Battalion ke vidrohi sipahi alag-alag dishaon me badhte rahe. Doranda ki tukadi 11 September 1857 ko wahan se chali tatha Ghouriya naam ke sthal par unhe Bhola Singh naam ke ek zamindar bhi mila, jo unke saath ho liya. Iske baad woh Kara tatha Ghandwa hote hue Chatra ki or badhe; kaha jaata hai ki unka irada Palamau se hokar jaane ka tatha Rohtasgarh ke paas Kunwar Singh ki sena se milkar ek saajha morcha banane ka tha. Isi tarah Chotanagpur tatha Bhojpur ke vidrohi aapas me sampark banaye rakhne ka prayas kar rahe the, jisse unka sangharsh ek bade roop me badal sake. Lekin 2 October 1857 ko Chatra ke paas angreji sena ke saath unka ghora mukabla hua, jisme unhe bahut nuksan uthana pada. Exam point: Doranda se nikle vidrohi Ghouriya me Bhola Singh se mile tatha unka irada Rohtasgarh ke paas Kunwar Singh ki sena se judne ka tha; raste me Chatra me unhe angreji sena se ladna pada.

qe: Which officer started for Palamau on 16 January 1858 with 140 Madras sepoys, a party of Ramgarh cavalry and a body of matchlockmen, and attacked the Palamau fort held by the insurgents?
qh: कौन-सा अधिकारी 16 जनवरी 1858 को 140 मद्रास सिपाहियों, रामगढ़ की घुड़सवार टुकड़ी तथा बंदूकधारियों के साथ पलामू के लिए रवाना हुआ और विद्रोहियों के कब्जे वाले पलामू किले पर हमला किया?
e: Palamau me vidroh ke phailne par angreji sarkar ne us kshetra ko dabane ke liye ek bada abhiyan chalaya. 16 January 1858 ko Captain Dalton apne saath ek sau chalis Madras ke sipahi, Ramgarh cavalry ki ek chhoti tukadi tatha matchlockmen yaani purani bandukon wale sainik lekar Palamau ki or rawana hue; Parganait Jagat Pal Singh ki command me yeh matchlockmen angreji sarkar ke sahayak the. Dalton 21 January ko Manka pahunche tatha raat me Lieutenant Graham bhi unse aa mile; agle din subah unhone Palamau ke kile par hamla kiya, jise vidrohiyon ne apne kabze me liya hua tha. Vidrohiyon ne kuchh samay tak bahut bahaduri se mukabla kiya, lekin ant me woh apne morche chhod kar alag-alag dishaon me nikal gaye. Isi tarah angreji sena ko Palamau ke vibhinn bhaagon me vidrohiyon ka peechha karna pada. Exam point: Captain Dalton 16 January 1858 ko 140 Madras sipahiyon tatha Ramgarh cavalry ke saath Palamau rawana huye tatha 21 January ko Manka pahunch kar agle din vidrohiyon ke kabze wale Palamau kile par hamla kiya.

qe: The underlying object of the Birsa movement was the internal purification of society by eradication of social evils, along with which other objective?
qh: बिरसा आंदोलन का मूल उद्देश्य सामाजिक बुराइयों के अंत द्वारा समाज की आंतरिक शुद्धि था, तथा उसके साथ कौन-सा अन्य उद्देश्य जुड़ा हुआ था?
oe: The spread of English education among the Mundas
The abolition of the village headman system
The migration of the Mundas to the plains
The removal of the alien government and of its supporters
oh: मुंडाओं में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का प्रसार
मुंडाओं का मैदानी इलाकों में प्रवास
विदेशी सरकार तथा उसके समर्थकों को हटाना
e: Birsa andaolan ka mukhya adarsh tha samaj ka bhitar se sudhar yaani samajik buriyon ka ant. Isi ke saath-saath andaolan ka doosra bada maksad tha angreji hukumat tatha uske sahayakon, jaise zamindaron tatha anya labh-lene wale vargon ko hatana. Aadivasi kshetra me zamindar tatha bichauliyon ne unki zameen tatha upjau bhoomi par kabza badhaya tha, jisse log khud ko beghar tatha karz me dubta pate the. Birsa ki sena tatha samarthakon ne logon ki sahayata ki tatha ise lokapriyata mili, isliye yah andaolan bahut tezi se phailte gaye tatha kai gaon ke log uske saath jude. Isi tarah ek dharmik-samajik sudhar andaolan ne bhi angreji hukumat ke khilaf ek rajniti sangharsh ka roop le liya. Exam point: Birsa andaolan ka uddeshya samajik buriyon ke ant se samaj ki shudhhi ke saath-saath angreji hukumat tatha uske sahayakon ko hatana bhi tha.

qe: On 2 October 1857 the insurgents had a severe engagement with British troops under which officer at Chatra, and were defeated with heavy casualties?
qh: 2 अक्टूबर 1857 को विद्रोहियों का चतरा में किस अधिकारी के नेतृत्व वाली ब्रिटिश सैना से भीषण मुकाबला हुआ, जिसमें उन्हें भारी नुकसान के साथ हार मिली?
e: Chotanagpur kshetra me vidroh ka phailav tez hone par angreji sarkar ne bhi apni taiyariyan badhayin. Doranda, Ranchi tatha Hazaribagh se nikle vidrohi sipahi Chatra ki or badh rahe the, jahan unka sangathan ek badi sena ka roop le raha tha. 2 October 1857 ko Chatra ke paas Major English ke netritva wali British sena tatha Sikh sipahiyon ke saath unka bhishan mukabla hua, jisme vidrohiyon ko bahut bhaari nuksan uthana pada tatha woh bikhar gaye. Sikh sipahiyon ko Lt. Erie command kar raha tha tatha unke saath angreji sena ki anya tukadiyan bhi thin. Is haar ke baad bhi vidroh Poori tarah khatm nahi hua; uske neta alag-alag kshetron me samay-samay par sangharsh karte rahe tatha angreji sarkar ko kai mahine tak Chotanagpur me unka peechha karna pada. Exam point: 2 October 1857 ko Chatra ke paas Major English ki British sena se hui ladai me vidrohi haare tatha unhe bhaari nuksan hua; Sikh sipahiyon ki command Lt. Erie ke paas thi.

qe: In the baggage left behind by the insurgents of Palamau, British officers discovered letters written to Lilambar, Pitambar and Naldaut Nanji, and correspondence from which leader promising help?
qh: पलामू के विद्रोहियों द्वारा छोड़े गए सामान में अंग्रेजी अधिकारियों को लीलांबर, पीतांबर तथा नलदउत ननजी के नाम पत्र मिले, तथा सहायता का वादा करने वाले किस नेता का पत्राचार भी मिला?
e: Captain Dalton ke abhiyan me vidrohi apne morche chhod kar bhaag gaye the, lekin apna bahut saara saaman woh peeche chhod gaye. Is saaman ki talashi lene par angreji adhikariyon ko kuchh aham kagaz mile, jinme Lilambar, Pitambar tatha Naldaut Nanji ke naam likhe gaye patra shamil the. In patraon me Bihar ke anya hisson se bhi sampark ka pata chalta tha; sabse mahatvapurna baat yah thi ki unhe Amar Singh ka likha patra bhi mila, jisme unse jaldi sahayata bhejne ka vaada kiya gaya tha. Amar Singh Kunwar Singh ke bhai the tatha unke netritva me Bhojpur kshetra me vidroh chalta raha. Is tarah ke patraaon se saaf hota hai ki Bihar ke alag-alag kshetron ke vidrohi aapas me sampark banaye hue the tatha milkar ladne ki yojana banate the, chahe unke kshetra ek doosre se door the. Exam point: Palamau ke vidrohiyon ke chhode saaman me Lilambar, Pitambar tatha Naldaut Nanji ke naam patra tatha Amar Singh ka sahayata ka vaada karne wala patra mila, jisse saajha yojana ka pata chala.

qe: In the first Birsa movement of 1895, what punishment in default of payment of fine was awarded to Birsa along with rigorous imprisonment?
qh: 1895 के पहले बिरसा आंदोलन में, बिरसा को कठोर कारावास के साथ-साथ जुर्माना न देने पर कौन-सी सज़ा दी गई थी?
oe: An additional six months of rigorous imprisonment
An additional two years of transportation
An additional fine of five hundred rupees
An additional year of simple imprisonment
oh: छह महीने का अतिरिक्त कठोर कारावास
पाँच सौ रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना
एक वर्ष का अतिरिक्त साधारण कारावास
e: Birsa ke netritva me pehla bada aandolan 1895 me hua. Is saal August ki kisi raat me, jab Birsa tatha uske kuch anuyayi so rahe the, unhe chupke se giraftar kar liya gaya. Un sabhi logon ko do-do saal ke kathor yaani rigorous kaaravas ki saza di gayi, aur Birsa par pachaas rupaye ka jurmana bhi lagaya gaya; jurmana na dene par use chhah mahine ka atirikt kathor kaaravas bhugtna pada. Kathor kaaravas me kaidi ko mushkil kaam karne padte the, jabki sadharan kaaravas me aise kaam nahi hote the. Us samay Ranchi ke Deputy Commissioner ne khushi jatayi thi ki yah andaolan poori tarah dab gaya, lekin unka yah anuman galat sabit hua; jail se riha hone ke baad Birsa ne apne andaolan ko aur bhi tez kar diya. Exam point: 1895 me Birsa tatha uske anuyayiyon ko do saal ke kathor kaaravas ki saza mili tatha Birsa par pachaas rupaye ka jurmana laga, jise na dene par chhah mahine ka atirikt kathor kaaravas bhugtna pada.

qe: Which Jamadar of the Ramgarh Battalion evaded capture throughout the disturbances, though the Company's Government put a reward of one thousand rupees on his head?
qh: रामगढ़ बटालियन का कौन-सा जमादार इन उपद्रवों के दौरान पकड़ा नहीं जा सका, हालाँकि कंपनी सरकार ने उसके सिर पर एक हज़ार रुपये का इनाम रखा था?
e: Ramgarh Battalion ke sainikon ne Hazaribagh tatha Ranchi me vidroh ka netritva kiya tatha unme se kuch adhikari angreji sarkar ke haath na aaye. Jamadar Madhab Singh Ramgarh Infantry ki do companies ke saath vidroh kar ke Ranchi ki or badha tha tatha poore upadrav ke dauran woh angreji sarkar ke haath nahi aaya; uski giraftari ke liye Company sarkar ne ek hazaar rupaye ka inam tak rakh diya. Iske vipreet Ramgarh Battalion ke do anya adhikari, Subedar Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan, 3 October ko Major Simpson ke saamne pesh kiye gaye; un par 1857 ke Act XVII ke tahat mukadma chalaya gaya tatha dono ko maut ki saza sunayi gayi. In giraftariyon ke baad bhi vidroh Chotanagpur tatha Singhbhum me kuchh samay tak chalta raha. Exam point: Jamadar Madhab Singh vidroh ke dauran pakda nahi ja saka, chahe uske sir par ek hazaar rupaye ka inam tha; Ramgarh Battalion ke Subedar Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan 3 October 1857 ko pakad liye gaye tatha unhe maut ki saza mili.

qe: For a crusade of this kind Birsa organised a fighting force trained in the use of the bow and arrow and the sword; who was placed in charge of this training as Minister and Commander-in-Chief?
qh: इस प्रकार के संग्राम के लिए बिरसा ने धनुष-बाण तथा तलवार के प्रयोग में प्रशिक्षित लड़ाकू दल खड़ा किया; उस प्रशिक्षण का भार मंत्री तथा सेनापति के रूप में किसे सौंपा गया?
e: Birsa ne samjha ki is tarah ke sangram ke liye ek sashastra sena ki zaroorat hai, jisme logon ko dhanush-baan tatha talwar chalane ki acchi training di jaye. Isi kaam ke liye usne apne najdiki saathi tatha pramukh salahkar Gaya Munda ko senapati banaya. Birsa ka sapna ek nayi samajik vyavastha ka tha, jisme aadivasi logon ko unki zameen tatha samman wapas mile. Yah thik hai ki Birsa ne dhanush-baan ka istemal karne wali ek sena banayi. Us samay Birsa ke saath kiye gaye kai anya sahayak the, jaise Demka Munda, Panau Munda, Sundat Munda tatha Tripru Munda, jinhe mahatvapurna zimmedariyan di gayi thi. Dhyan rakhne wali baat yah hai ki Birsa ki sena ne talwar tatha dhanush-baan se ladne ki training li thi, lekin angrejon ke paas astra-shastra bahut aadhunik the. Exam point: Birsa ne dhanush-baan tatha talwar ke prashikshan wali sena banayi tatha uske pramukh salahkar Gaya Munda ko senapati banaya; anya sahayak the Demka Munda, Panau Munda tatha Sundat Munda.

qe: Subedars Jai Mangal Pande and Nadir Ali Khan of the Ramgarh Battalion were captured and tried under the provisions of which Act of 1857?
qh: रामगढ़ बटालियन के सूबेदार जयमंगल पांडे तथा नादिर अली खान पकड़े गए थे तथा उन पर 1857 के किस अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के अंतर्गत मुकदमा चलाया गया?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ko dabaane ke liye angreji sarkar ne kuchh vishesh kanoon bhi banaye, jinme unhe vidrohiyon par jaldi mukadma chalane tatha sakht saza dene ki shakti mili. Ramgarh Battalion ke do Subedar, Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan, vidroh ka netritva karne ke aarop me 3 October 1857 ko Major Simpson ke saamne pesh kiye gaye. Subedar yaani us samay ki deshi paidal sena me ek adhikari, jo ek company ke barabar ke sainikon ki command karta tha. Dono par 1857 ke Act XVII ke prabandhon ke tahat mukadma chalaya gaya tatha unhe maut ki saza sunayi gayi. Isi tarah vidroh ke dauran pakde gaye kai netaon tatha sipahiyon par alag-alag adalaton me mukadme chalaye gaye tatha unhe desh-nikale ya maut ki saza di gayi. Exam point: Ramgarh Battalion ke Subedar Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan par 1857 ke Act XVII ke tahat mukadma chal kar dono ko maut ki saza di gayi.

qe: Which place near Ranchi became the headquarters of the revolutionary force organised by Birsa, while training centres were started at Ranchi, Chakradharpur, Bandu and Tamar?
qh: बिरसा द्वारा खड़ी की गई क्रांतिकारी सेना का मुख्यालय रांची के पास किस स्थान पर बना, जबकि प्रशिक्षण केंद्र रांची, चक्रधरपुर, बांदू तथा तमाड़ में खोले गए?
e: Birsa ne apne andaolan ko ek sashastra roop dene ke liye ek niyamit sena banayi tatha uske liye prashikshan kendra khole. Ranchi ke paas Khunti is sena ka mukhyaalay bana, jabki Ranchi, Chakradharpur, Bandu, Tamar, Karra, Toipa, Basia tatha Sisai jaise sthalon par prashikshan kendra khole gaye. In kendraon me logon ko dhanush-baan tatha talwar chalane ki training di jaati thi tatha sena ke liye logon ko ikattha kiya jata tha. February 1898 se 24 December 1899 tak Birsa tatha uske updeshak saathi alag-alag sunsaan jagahon par raat ki baithkein karte tatha aage ki yojana banate the, jisse unka sangathan mazboot hota gaya. Isi tarah ek dharmik-samajik andaolan ne ek vyavasthit sena tatha prashikshan-kendraon ka roop le liya. Exam point: Birsa ki sena ka mukhyaalay Ranchi ke paas Khunti me bana tatha Ranchi, Chakradharpur, Bandu, Tamar jaise sthalon par training kendra khole gaye.

qe: Which two leading supporters of the rebels in the Chotanagpur area were captured at Kakraj in Lohardaga in March 1858 and hanged at Ranchi?
qh: छोटानागपुर क्षेत्र में विद्रोहियों के किन दो प्रमुख समर्थकों को मार्च 1858 में लोहरदगा के ककराज में पकड़ कर रांची में फाँसी दी गई?
oe: Tikait Unao Rao Singh and his diwan Shaikh Bikari
Thatur Biswanath Sahi of Barkargarh and Pandey Ganpat Rai of Bhownro
Raja Arjun Singh of Porhat and his brother
Pitambar Sahi and Lilambar Sahi of the Bhogta clan
oh: टिकैत उनाओ राव सिंह तथा उनके दीवान शेख बिकारी
बरकारगढ़ के ठाकुर विश्वनाथ साही तथा भौंरो के पांडेय गणपत राय
पोरहाट के राजा अर्जुन सिंह तथा उनके भाई
भोगता कुल के पीतांबर साही तथा लीलांबर साही
e: Chotanagpur tatha aas-paas ke kshetron me vidroh ko dabane ke liye angreji sarkar ne sakht kadam uthaye tatha vidrohiyon ke sahayakon ko pakadne ke liye kai muhim chalayin. Barkargarh ke Thatur Biswanath Sahi tatha Bhownro ke Pandey Ganpat Rai vidrohi sainikon ke pramukh samarthakon me the; unhone angreji sarkar ke khilaf morche banane me aham bhoomika nibhai thi. Kai gaon ke log inhe chhupaate the, isliye sarkar kuchh samay tak unhe nahi pakad payi. March 1858 me Lohardaga ke Kakraj naam ke sthal par Major Nation, jo aathvin Bengal Police Battalion ke Commandant the, ne unhe giraftar kar liya. Iske baad unhe Ranchi le jaaya gaya, jahan Commissioner ke compound ke uttar wale pedon par 16 tatha 21 April ko alag-alag din unhe phansi di gayi. Exam point: Barkargarh ke Biswanath Sahi tatha Bhownro ke Ganpat Rai ko March 1858 me Lohardaga ke Kakraj me pakda gaya tatha April 1858 me Ranchi me phansi di gayi.

qe: Birsa was captured on 3 February 1900 near which village, about two miles west of it, by pro-British watchmen who were paid a reward of Rs 500?
qh: बिरसा को 3 फरवरी 1900 को किस गाँव के पास, उससे लगभग दो मील पश्चिम में, सरकार-समर्थक चौकीदारों ने पकड़ लिया, जिन्हें पाँच सौ रुपये का इनाम मिला?
e: Angreji sarkar ne Birsa tatha uske saathiyon ko pakadne ke liye bahut prayas kiye, lekin unhe safalta nahi mili. Ant me kshetra ke kuch gaon ke sarkar-samarthak chaukidaron ne Birsa ka pata lagaya. Birsa apni patni tatha ek anya stri ke saath Sankra gaon se lagbhag do mile pashchim me jungle me the; jab teenon ek ped ke neeche aaram kar rahe the, tab chaukidaron ne chupke se jakar unhe pakad liya. Yah 3 February 1900 ki ghatna hai. Birsa ko giraftar karke sipahi police ki nigrani me Ranchi bheja gaya tatha wahan jail me rakha gaya, jabki uski patni ko Ranchi jane ki anumati nahi di gayi. Ranchi jail me kuchh hi mahine baad unhe pet ki bimari yaani cholera hua, jisse 1900 me hi unka dehant ho gaya. Exam point: Birsa 3 February 1900 ko Sankra gaon ke pashchim wale jungle se pakde gaye; pakadne wale chaukidaron ko paanch sau rupaye ka inam mila tatha Birsa ko Ranchi jail me rakha gaya.

qe: Raja Arjun Singh of which place, along with his brother, led a formidable rising of the Kols of Singhbhum during the disturbances of 1857-59?
qh: 1857-59 के उपद्रवों के दौरान किस स्थान के राजा अर्जुन सिंह ने अपने भाई के साथ सिंहभूम के कोलों का भयंकर विद्रोह खड़ा किया?
e: Singhbhum kshetra me Company sarkar ke khilaf asantosh purane samay se chali aa rahi thi tatha 1857 ke upadravon ne usse aur bhadka diya. Porhat ke raja Arjun Singh tatha unke bhai ke netritva me Kol logon ne angreji sarkar ke khilaf ek bhishan vidroh khada kiya. January 1858 ke madhya me unhone Company ki sena ko buri tarah haraya, jisme angreji sena ke lagbhag ek sau pachaas sipahi maidan me hi mare gaye. Iske baad Colonel Foster, jo Raniganj se Chaibasa pahunche the, ne Chakradharpur par vidrohiyon ko peeche dhakel diya tatha raaste me kai gaon jala diye. 1859 me Chaibasa ke Sheristadar Mewa Lal ki sahayata se Porhat ke raja ko giraftar kar liya gaya; uski jageerein zabt kar li gayi tatha unhe Banaras me rajya-bandi ke roop me rakha gaya, jahan unhe mahine ka char sau rupaye pension milta tha. Exam point: Porhat ke raja Arjun Singh tatha unke bhai ne Singhbhum me Kol vidroh ka netritva kiya tatha January 1858 me Company ki sena ko hara kar 150 sipahi maare; 1859 me unhe giraftar karke Banaras bheja gaya.

qe: After the capture of Birsa, eighty-seven of his followers were committed to session; what did the sessions court award to two of them?
qh: बिरसा की गिरफ्तारी के बाद उसके सत्तासी अनुयायियों को सेशन न्यायालय के सामने भेजा गया; सेशन न्यायालय ने उनमें से दो को कौन-सी सज़ा दी?
oe: A heavy fine with simple imprisonment
e: Birsa ki giraftari ke baad angreji sarkar ne uske bahut se saathiyon ko pakad liya. Ranchi tatha Singhbhum kshetra me unke mukadmon ki sunwai ke liye alag-alag adhikari niyukta kiye gaye. In mukadmon me Birsa ke sattasi anuyayiyon ko session yaani ghaur adalat me bheja gaya; inme se do ko mrityudand diya gaya tatha shesh ko alag-alag avadhi ke desh-nikale ya kaaravas ki saza di gayi. Kuchh kaidiyon ne appeal ki, jiske phal-swaroop kuch log riha ho gaye tatha kuch ki saza kam kar di gayi. Isi aadhaar par kai manki yaani vibhagiya mukhiyaon ko unki mankiship yaani mukhiyagiri se v1nchit kar diya gaya, jisse aadivasi samaj ki purani modi-shakti par chot pahunchi. Exam point: Birsa ke sattasi anuyayiyon ko session me bheja gaya, jinme se do ko mrityudand mila tatha shesh ko desh-nikale ya kaaravas ki saza; kuchh kaidi appeal par riha ho gaye.

qe: Which family of Patna, noted for its learning and piety, controlled the Wahabi movement's centre at Patna, prominent among its members being Maulvis Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Husain and Abdullah?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा परिवार, जो अपनी विद्वत्ता तथा धार्मिकता के लिए प्रसिद्ध था, पटना स्थित वहाबी आंदोलन केंद्र का नियंत्रण करता था, जिसके प्रमुख सदस्यों में मौलवी विलायत अली, इनायत अली, शाह मुहम्मद हुसैन तथा अब्दुल्ला थे?
e: Wahabi aandolan Bharat me Abdu l Wahab of Najd ki shikshaon par chala; yah ek dharmik aandolan tha, lekin isme angreji hukumat ko hatane ka rajniti maksad bhi shamil tha. Patna me is andaolan ka ek mahatvapurna kendra 1828 se 1868 tak, yaani chalis saal tak, chalta raha. Is kendra ko Patna ke ek sampann tatha padhe-likhe Muhammadan parivar ke log chalate the, jinhe Sadikpore parivar ke naam se jana jata hai. Is parivar ke pramukh log the Maulvi Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Husain tatha Abdullah, jinme se har ek ne aandolan me bada yogdan diya. Wilayat Ali apne chhote bhai Inayat Ali se rajniti samajh tatha anubhav me aage the, jabki Inayat Ali bahut joshila tatha utsahi the. Isi parivar ke prayason se Patna ka kendra Bengal tatha anya kshetron ke Wahabiyon ko dhan tatha naye logon ki sahayata deta raha. Exam point: Patna ka Wahabi kendra 1828 se 1868 tak Sadikpore parivar ke niyantran me raha, jiske pramukh log Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Husain tatha Abdullah the.

qe: Inayat Ali took over the command of the Wahabi forces at Sittana; after his death in 1869, who of Surajgarh in Monghyr took charge of that colony?
qh: इनायत अली ने सिताना में वहाबी सैनिकों की कमान संभाली; 1869 में उनके देहांत के बाद मुंगेर के सूरजगढ़ से किसने उस बस्ती का प्रभार लिया?
e: Patna ke Sadikpore parivar ke log Wahabi aandolan ke kendra tatha Sittana ki basti, donon ko chalate the. Sittana yaani us samay ke uttar-pashchim seemant kshetra ki ek basti, jahan Wahabiyon ki sena tatha apna alag prabandh tha. Wilayat Ali ke dehant ke baad Inayat Ali phir se andaolan ka neta ban gaya tatha usne Sittana me Wahabi sena ki command sambhali. 1869 me Inayat Ali ka bhi dehant ho gaya; uske baad Monghyr ke Surajgarh se aaye M. Maqsud Ali ne Sittana ki us basti ka prabandh sambhala. Maqsud Ali ke dehant ke baad Wilayat Ali ke putra M. Abdullah ne netritva sambhala tatha Bihar aur Bengal se naye log tatha dhan Sittana pahunchne lage. Is tarah Patna ka kendra sadi ke aakhir tak Bengal tatha seemant kshetra ke Wahabiyon ke beech ek pul ka kaam karta raha. Exam point: Inayat Ali ke 1869 ke dehant ke baad Monghyr ke Surajgarh ke M. Maqsud Ali ne Sittana ki Wahabi basti ka prabandh sambhala, tatha unke baad M. Abdullah netritva me aaye.
